messages.author: 917886a8636ac109
messages.subject: Thresholds
parts:
Hi there,

I was playing with the binary version of data embedded in Lavaan. I got the estimates of thresholds, but there are a few that are negative, how can I interpret these negative thresholds?

Thank you in advance!
Michael.

messages.author: 12fdd832cacb825e
messages.subject: Re: Thresholds
parts:
Michael,

You don't provide much information here, but a threshold of zero corresponds to a probability of .5 of endorsement of the item. A threshold below zero just means there's a great than .5 probability of endorsement--i.e., crossing a lower threshold.

Pat
